title: Agentic Neural Architecture Search
abstract: arXiv:2607.07984v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural architecture search (NAS) methods have grown increasingly efficient, but they still operate within manually designed search spaces that require domain expertise and must be rebuilt for each new task. Large language models (LLMs) can write architectures in an open-ended code space, yet it is unclear how the work should be divided between LLM-driven design and NAS-driven search. We propose a way to combine the two. An LLM first designs a seed architecture and then decomposes it into a slotted architecture: a scaffold with named, interchangeable module slots that defines a bounded, task-specific search space, which a conventional NAS algorithm then explores without any manual engineering. We implement this in AgentNAS, a three-phase pipeline whose phases can be evaluated separately. translated_abstract: 神经架构搜索（NAS）方法已经变得越来越高效，但它们仍然在人工设计的搜索空间内运行，这需要领域专业知识，并且必须为每个新任务重新构建。大型语言模型（LLM）可以在开放式代码空间中编写架构，然而如何在LLM驱动的设计与NAS驱动的搜索之间划分工作尚不明确。我们提出了一种结合两者的方法。LLM首先设计一个种子架构，然后将其分解为槽位架构：这是一种带有命名且可互换模块槽位的骨架，它定义了一个有界的、任务特定的搜索空间，随后由传统NAS算法进行探索，无需任何人工工程。我们在AgentNAS中实现了这一方法，这是一个三阶段流水线，其各阶段可以分别评估。在来自NAS-Bench-360和Unseen NAS的17个任务上，涵盖分类、密集回归、分割和多标签标注，AgentNAS的表现优于……
tldr: 提出AgentNAS，利用LLM将种子架构分解为带命名可互换模块槽位的骨架，自动定义有界的任务特定搜索空间，使传统NAS算法无需人工设计即可在其中搜索，并覆盖多种任务类型。
en_tdlr: AgentNAS uses an LLM to decompose a seed architecture into a slotted scaffold that automatically defines a bounded, task-specific search space, enabling conventional NAS to search without any manual engineering.
